description: Email verification / email validation: will mail to this address arrive? Checked live at the source: syntax, the domain's DNS (MX, null MX, no such domain) and its own mail server, asked whether the mailbox exists and whether it accepts any address (catch-all). No message sent. Flags disposable domains, role accounts (info@), free providers and typos (gmial.com). Verdict: deliverable, undeliverable, risky or unknown, with the reason. Input: email. $0.10 per call.
name: hubvibe_email_verify
title: Verify an email address before you send
